column1: # tools/coverage-data/coverage-history.tsv — cooldown and give-up ledger for the coverage-qa pipeline.
# Append-only. Each row records the outcome of one coverage-qa round for
# one selection unit (a Java package or a Python directory). select-target.py
# reads this file to (a) skip a unit selected within COOLDOWN_DAYS of its
# most recent row, and (b) auto-exclude a unit that has been attempted
# MAX_ATTEMPTS times in a row without MIN_PROGRESS percentage points of
# gain on any attempt. The coverage-qa agent appends one row per round as
# part of its PR — never edits or removes an existing row.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   timestamp   UTC, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ" — when the round ran
#   unit        the Java package (dotted) or Python directory (slashed)
#   language    "java" or "python"
#   before_pct  line coverage percentage before this round
#   after_pct   line coverage percentage after this round (same value as
#               before_pct when the round made no honest progress)
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored by select-target.py.
